**Highlights**

- **Dedalus HealthCare DACH** (11/2020 – Present): Migrated the medical 3D visualization module from C++/DirectX 9 to Rust + WebAssembly + WebGL/OpenGL and TypeScript. Repackaged it as a framework-agnostic Web Component that ships in two host products (Angular and React). Built a side-by-side comparison system to validate performance and visuals during the migration, and added component-level E2E tests with Storybook and Playwright.
- **Self-employed** (11/2019 – 05/2020): Practiced TDD and pair/mob programming with 9 teams in 4 countries. Co-organized the Mob-Programming on Open Source Software meetup in Austria.
- **three10** (09/2016 – 10/2019): One of two principal engineers in a team of 6. Built a JavaScript library that streams server-side Unity 3D graphics to the browser over a low-latency video codec. Owned the Docker/Node.js/React backend architecture and secure file transfer.
- **ViewAR** (04/2015 – 08/2016): Extended the C++ AR core and integrated third-party AR/VR SDKs. Generated watertight meshes and volume estimates from depth-sensor scans for a Lufthansa Cargo pallet-volume system. Cross-compiled the core to WebGL with Emscripten/WebAssembly.
- **Agfa HealthCare** (10/2013 – 04/2015): Main engineer for the GPU/CPU volume rendering engine, including SIMD-optimized CPU rendering. Implemented bi-cubic filtering for WebGL resampling and replaced per-platform build scripts with CMake.
- **Agfa HealthCare** (09/2010 – 09/2013): Implemented 3D visualization and volume data loading features, including progressive loading of volume image data (patent granted).

## About this repository

My resume as data, plus the projects that render it:

| Path | What |
| --- | --- |
| [content/resume.yaml](content/resume.yaml) | **Single source of truth** ([JSON Resume](https://jsonresume.org/schema) schema + `x-` fields) |
| [latex/](latex/) | PDF resume ([AltaCV](https://github.com/liantze/AltaCV)); layout in `main.tex`, content from `generated/resume-data.tex` |
| [3d-resume/](3d-resume/) | WebGPU 3D resume (Rust, wgpu, winit) for the browser and desktop |
| [crates/resume-model/](crates/resume-model/) | Content model: loads, validates and normalizes the YAML |
| [crates/resume-gen/](crates/resume-gen/) | Generates the LaTeX data, this README, the plain HTML page and the JSON schema |

Workflow:

```sh
# 1. Edit content/resume.yaml (VS Code validates it against content/resume.schema.json)
cargo gen all        # 2. regenerate LaTeX data, README.md, plain.html, schema
sh latex/build.sh    # 3. build the PDF
cargo run -p resume-3d --release         # 3D resume, native
cd 3d-resume && trunk serve --open       # 3D resume, browser (needs WebGPU)
```

`cargo gen check` (also run in CI) fails when a generated file is out of date.
